care_team_notes: Encourage early contact with the relevant state MND association, MND advisor, GP, allied health team, NDIS/My Aged Care pathways and carer-specific supports before crisis points.
description: MND-specific carer information about changing responsibilities, emotional impact, practical learning, equipment, symptoms, planning ahead, MND associations, Carer Gateway and family support.
name: Caring for a loved one with MND

care_team_notes: Use Carer Gateway for carer needs assessment, local provider connection, respite planning, emergency care planning and carer wellbeing support.
description: Australian Government carer program providing counselling, coaching, peer support, online skills courses, tailored support packages, planned respite and emergency respite.
name: Carer Gateway services

care_team_notes: Plan respite early; for older people check My Aged Care assessment and for carer-specific support check Carer Gateway.
description: Information about respite options including in-home, community, cottage and residential respite, plus emergency respite pathways when the carer suddenly cannot provide care.
name: Planned and emergency respite

care_team_notes: Check eligibility and current rates directly with Services Australia; encourage carers to review changes in care load, work, study, income and relationship status.
description: Australian payment information for carers, including Carer Payment, Carer Allowance, Carer Supplement and related claim or account-management steps.
name: Carer payments and allowances

care_team_notes: Ask whether children, teenagers or young adults are providing care; connect them with young carer supports and avoid assuming the adult carer is the only caregiver.
description: Support pathways for young carers under 25, including study, work, wellbeing, connection and age-appropriate help.
name: Young carers

care_team_notes: Offer family meetings, age-appropriate explanation, counselling or social-work input when MND is affecting parenting, couple relationships, children or household roles.
description: MND-specific information about relationship changes, talking with children and young people, family adjustment and emotional support for carers, partners and friends.
name: Family, relationships and children

care_team_notes: Use the person's location to connect carers with the right state carer association, state government carer supports, Carer Gateway provider and MND association.
description: State, territory and national carer support services, including carer associations, local support groups, advisory services, concessions, respite and advocacy pathways.
name: State and territory carer services
